title: Bob & Bob movie!
author: bpatrick
body: I’m super excited to announce a short film based on Bob & Bob by Andrew Alonso!!! Here’s the poster – which is incredible – and I’ve seen some stills and it looks amazing! I’ll be sure to let everyone know when it’s done and where you can see it. It is going to be fucking awesome.

comments.author: Jonny Paycheck
comments.text: This is so cool. Bob & Bob was pretty much the reason I found your art; one of my early favorites. Be sure to point us in the right direction to find this movie when it’s complete.

comments.author: Zian
comments.text: super exciting, bob & bob was also my first experience with these comics. it’s going to be fantastic.

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.text: Thanks everyone! I think it’s going to be amazing!

comments.author: Boris
comments.text: Aye, this was the first thing I read of yours and I was blown away. I distinctly remember thinking it would make a kickass movie – hope this does it justice.

comments.author: Tatti
comments.text: Shiit, this is absolutely great news!!! Do they already have a webpage or something? Super excited here 😀

comments.author: lily
comments.text: bob & bob is fantastic (actually all of your comics are fucking amazing), and i would really like to see the movie… how and where and when can i get a hold of it?!
